import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json,re,hashlib
from html import unescape
p=Path.cwd()
def w(n,s):
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
s=(p/'sources/difference-basis-prior.html').read_text();a=s.index('<div class="postcell');s=s[a:s.index('id="footer"') if 'id="footer"' in s else len(s)];text=unescape(re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',s));print(re.sub(r'\s+',' ',text)[:26000]);print('LINKS',re.findall(r'href="([^"]*(?:arxiv|pdf)[^"]*)"',s))
prov=json.loads((p/'provenance.json').read_text())
for v in prov:
 raw=(p/f"originals/{v['id']}.jsonl").read_bytes(); token=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*("(?:\\.|[^"\\])*")',raw).group(1);v['raw_statement_json_token_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest();v['decoded_statement_utf8_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(json.loads(raw)['statement'].encode()).hexdigest();v['newline_preserved']=raw.endswith(b'\n')
w('provenance.json',json.dumps(prov,indent=2))
